audit.why: Both layers and the packet chart agree: Katarina takes all seven rows, FAVOURED 4/10, 51.18% over 3523 games. No side or rating moved.
audit.corrected: Only the seven why strings were rewritten — they were the generic Katarina boilerplate with nothing about Twisted Fate in them.

audit.why: Level 3 Q-W-E kills through his stat line; level 6 Death Lotus (75/60/45s) beats Destiny (170/140/110s) because his ult only relocates; first item out-damages a Rod of Ages line; two items her reset teamfighting outscales his pick pattern.
audit.corrected: Spikes array already grounded; left intact.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digits, and nowhere did the page say Pick a Card is an auto-attack reset or that Gold Card cancels Death Lotus.
audit.why: Pick a Card is flagged autoReset and hardCC, and it is a flat 6s at every rank — that number is the whole rhythm of the lane. Death Lotus is flagged channel, so a Gold Card stun cancels the ultimate outright. Wild Cards is 6/5.75/5.5/5.25/5s; Destiny is 170/140/110s.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with all three numbers and the auto-reset tell; dontsFull[2] now states the Gold-Card-cancels-Lotus interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[10].t says 'Gank for HER' about Twisted Fate, who is male.
audit.why: champ-gender.js does not list twistedfate as female.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d were both bodies that did not answer their titles.
audit.why: Two flagged by lint; the other two are the same defect class.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten against their own titles.

edits.before: Q the wave and collect the dagger — every pickup is a free spin; the lane learns your dagger geometry or bleeds.
edits.after: Wild Cards is a slow skillshot and he has no dash — walk up alongside your dagger and punish every last-hit.

edits.before: W joins: drop, dance, collect — the self-dagger speeds your trades and your exits both.
edits.after: Q plus W's burst of move speed runs him down before Pick a Card is ever reliable.

edits.before: Full kit: E to daggers, not faces — the blink economy is the champion; trade only through steel on the ground.
edits.after: Pick a Card is 6s flat — the full Q-W-E string kills through his squishy stat line every time it is down.

edits.before: Dagger-trade on cooldown: Q-E-W-E strings chunk and the resets... wait for kills. Bank the patterns.
edits.after: Dagger control zones him off CS and he has no dash — Shunpo is a sentence he cannot answer.

edits.before: Death Lotus online — any 2v2 near your daggers is a blender invoice. The reset engine is armed.
edits.after: Death Lotus kills, Destiny only teleports — and his 1.5s Gate channel is a free kill for you.

edits.before: First item spike: full dagger strings delete squishies and one kill opens the chain reaction.
edits.after: Your first-item spike out-damages his Rod of Ages line in any all-in he cannot walk out of.

edits.before: Late Kata is a chain reaction: enter on daggers, lotus the clump, reset through the wreckage, repeat until silence.
edits.after: Your reset teamfighting outscales his single-target pick pattern — track Pick a Card, then dive his backline.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. It governs your forward steps. - E Shunpo (second use) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Pick a Card is a flat 6s at every rank and it is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. - Wild Cards is 6s down to 5s and is his only other damage. - Destiny is 170/140/110s; with it down he cannot flank-teleport, so force fights there.

edits.before: Twisted Fate wins by landing Pick a Card (Gold), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Twisted Fate wins by holding Gold Card for your Shunpo, then Wild Cards and a jungler landing on a stunned Katarina.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by counting to six: Pick a Card down means no CC in the lane, and every reset after that is free money.

edits.before: The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Wild Cards fires three cards in a spread — keep a minion line between you and him and the spread eats the wave instead of you.

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: The instant Pick a Card is spent you have six seconds with no CC in the lane — that is the string.

edits.before: Twisted Fate spends Pick a Card (Gold) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Gold Card is a point-and-click stun — keep the second Shunpo banked so a landed card is not a death.

edits.before: That is Twisted Fate’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: He pre-selects Gold Card and waits for you to stand still.

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Gold Card is a stun and Death Lotus is a channel — a held card cancels your whole ult, so bait it before you spin.

edits.before: Gank for HER: any CC your jungler lands is a full string plus lotus — ping the dagger-banked windows and watch the chain react.
edits.after: Gank for HIM: Twisted Fate has one stun and no dash, so any jungler CC becomes a full string plus Lotus and a reset.

notes: Chart was already consistent across both layers and the packet, so no side or win[] edits were needed — only the seven boilerplate why strings. The highest-value missing fact on this page: Pick a Card is an auto-attack RESET, so the tell is the wind-up rather than the cast, and because Gold Card is hard CC it cancels Death Lotus outright — neither was stated anywhere. suspectNames flagged 'Gold Card' in spikes[0]; Gold Card is the correct in-game name for the yellow Pick a Card selection and is a false positive against 'Wild Cards'. The '21 base armor' figure asserted in content.early is not in the kit file; I did not repeat it and list it in unverified.
